implementation.targetScope: PNG.sync.read for application figure validation and RGBA pixel inspection, plus new PNG({width,height}) and PNG.sync.write for the historical-importer fixture. Static/default image decoding remains complete across legal color/depth formats, transparency, filters and Adam7. Writing is normalized non-interlaced RGBA8 with optional gamma. No async stream API or alternate writer modes.

changes: Independent bounded chunk parser, scanline reconstruction and sample conversion, using supported-runtime zlib inflate and CRC32.
Input and pixel bounds before bitmap allocation; exact inflated lengths including Adam7 passes and strict chunk ordering/CRC checks.
No streaming implementation, compatibility shims or third-party runtime dependencies; the supported application contract is synchronous reading and RGBA8 fixture construction/writing.
Follow PNG decoder compatibility rules for final IDAT padding, transparency-key high bits and empty palette transparency.

Independent bounded RGBA8 writer and zero-filled constructor; native zlib/CRC32, fixed first-row Sub/later-row Up filters, exact input length, finite allocation/output limits and preserved pixels/gamma.

verification.corpus: 162 exact valid PNG comparisons; 14 invalid files rejected. Missing-IDAT upstream outcome is runtime/state-dependent and not an equality control. Corpus revision and hashes live in scripts/png-conformance/images.json.

application.tests: 28 unchanged problemImage tests pass against upstream and VPM on Bun 1.4.0; source copies temporary only.

verification.limitations: No async parser, stream constructor, pack, bitblt, gamma adjustment, skipRescale output or animation-frame API. Writer is RGBA8/non-interlaced only; no custom filter/deflate options. Defaults: 16 million pixels and 10 MiB; callers with larger accepted bounds must pass explicit limits.
